notes.title: 'UXcalibur' Update: Weekly Tournaments, Auto-Cam, Sectors & Other improvements!
notes.content:
Hello Runners ❤️‍🔥

This update brings you a bunch of user experience improvements, both small and big! 


Weekly Tournaments
Every Monday we select a random community map for the Weekly Tournament. Results lock the following Monday. Ghosts are revealed on the livestream, where we also unveil the next map!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/2fc27aac7b8e0ad6e234400bea2e3d3d5311397d.png"]Auto-cam
If you're playing on controller you no longer need to touch the Right Stick, don't believe me? Watch me beat the game without touching camera once! It's the auto-cam's first version so your feedback is much appreciated to help us improve further. You can also use Right Stick press to quickly reset the camera.
[previewyoutube="4Y0OqVOKs5I;full"][/previewyoutube]Sprays
Select your spray and use \[G] to leave your mark on the environment (also works in Multiplayer). We're happy to add your own custom sprays, just send them to our Discord.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/9bef91679e5098ce81a023e8fc8295b78e976805.png"]
HUD Lab
Enable Pro mode in the HUD Lab to track sector times, compare against your best run, and see your current best time. It’s a powerful tool to improve your performance and helps your audience instantly follow the action.

This great idea came from the community - if you have more suggestions, leave them on our Discord.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/c74587673183f4fb31a1fe3fb54fa1df221b6987.png"]
Multiplayer
 While in the Multiplayer lobby you can now download and add community maps without having to go into main menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/7af5693f530d6c31cd5612d40db2025aa2a7c3b1.png"]
Level Select
We added new tabs into level select that allow you to view how many tokens you collected in each level, what's your world rank or amount of restarts per each level. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/4a449188597287d7decc86774a4ad3fd6d9a754d.png"]
New Skins
Two new community skins added: Lumberjill by Kironet and Egger by Big Egg. You can also create your own skin! Just reach out on our Discord and we'll teach you how, it's quite easy.
[previewyoutube="y3iM93wgPEs;full"][/previewyoutube]

Full Changelog
* Free camera setting moved to in-game setting

* FPS display setting moved to in-game setting

* Tournaments showing 'in XY hours/minutes"

* Global statistics header updated accordingly to filters

* Screenshots

   - Stored in dedicated directory

   - Stored as PNG

   - Official in-game screenshot (F10, in settings)

   - Shutter sound

   - Can be super-sized (settings/game/misc)

* Automatic camera improvements

* Controller support for map creations - single click on A instead of doubleclick

* When spectating ghost, escape will trigger 'play solo'

+ Create mode

   - Map name and description check before upload

   - Start/Exit prefabs checks before upload

   - Typing in input field does not trigger editor actions

   - Mouse scroll does not affect editor when scrolling in other windows

+ Sectors for maps

+ HUD lab

   - Supports notifications

   - Switched on/off per element

   - Personal best for map and sectors can be enabled

+ Camera reset (Q and/or right controller stick press)

+ Tokens displayed in level table per map

+ Controller auto camera for nitro/flying

+ Vibrations enabled for build

+ Archived maps opened with level select achievement

+ World ranks in level select

+ Scroll view tool for capturing whole scroll area screenshot

+ Lumberjill and Egger skins

+ Multiplayer: adding community maps to library from lobby

+ Mod support : is finish screen & booleans block marked in memory

+ Multiple tag support - two tags only for testing

+ Hints can be disabled from settings game/misc

+ Vibrations power in settings

+ Auto camera enabled for controller

+ Intro skipping polished ('Hold to skip' + radial progress bar)

@ FPS counter disappearing fixed

@ Steam : forcing restart after branch update (preventing need of manual restart)

@ Multiplayer

   - Counting map time from previos map

   - 'Map does nopt support leaderboard' when party leaderboard is present in lock screen

@ Lost UI selection in hub pause menu

@ Auto camera controller/keyboard switch fixed

@ Crash during game closing

@ Statistics sorting: 'jumping' lines with empty entries

@ Intro looping fixed

@ Intro 'Hold to skip' text disappearing

@ Multiplayer button is not skipped when main menu is displayed for first time

@ Ghosts do not play vibration effects



If there's something else you'd like to see in the next update, drop a comment on this post.



Or even better, join our Discord

notes.title: 'Reborn' Update: Public Multiplayer Beta & More
notes.content:
Hello Runners ❤️‍🔥

Are you ready for the new era of rocket-powered parkour? See what's new below.


Public Multiplayer Beta 
You can now race online in the main build! Like & Share this video across your Discord servers 🤩
[previewyoutube="l688gVNjUUw;full"][/previewyoutube]Tournaments
We added a tournament system that allows us to run multiple tournaments at the same time! You can also view past and planned tournaments directly from the main menu.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/f0d97d67af5c2acd39654e41e928ad6ba9021cd2.png"]
Steam Racing Fest Tournament
Anyone (even demo players) can compete in this tournament on the new map by LinT. Join from Main Menu > Tournaments. If you're a demo user and land in the top 3 you get a free Steam key.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/85ade0100fd869ee83d0f10bb5860f1c908ed9de.png"]
Exclusive Creator Tournament
This VIP event is part of our first official marketing campaign. Selected influencers will compete for a grand cash prize of 1000 USD for claiming the #1 spot. If you'd like to get into this exclusive competition, please contact us. 



Note: To make the Creator Tournament fair, some conditions on entry apply (i.e. your current playtime must be less than 10 hours). But don't worry, there will be more cash prize tournaments in the near future - accessible to everyone, including demo users.


General Improvements
New Intro, highlighting new features - don't skip, it only plays once! (unless changed in settings)

Welcome screen, recap of key features

Main menu, optimized performance

Start animation, transitions to sprint faster

Jungle-Maze, last loading point optimized to avoid micro-freezing

Islands-Nitro, made ramps wider and non-climbable in the center

Navigation, fixed controller navigation on various places

Localization, improved and streamlined to fit the new UI

Settings, framerate setting is now more user-friendly

Ghosts, support for selected tournaments

Disappearing hub, fixed an issue in case user profile migration from pc to another pc

Entrances, blind-fix preventing entrances loading issue


Multiplayer
Public build can enable multiplayer with code

Sessions with track/heat/current map number displayed

Added refresh button for lobbies

Rocket islands allowed for multiplayer games from beginning

Player UI (speed, time, tokens) hidden when spectating

Host ending session will close the lobby

Fixed missing version when connecting to lobby with different build


Cremo
Checkpoint-related crashes fix

Minimalistic start model added

Tracks produce footstep sounds now

Removed unnecessary rotation from billboard

Deadly rotator collision fixed



We're aware of requests related to additional controller support and will prioritize these in the upcoming updates. If there's something else you'd like to see in the next update, drop a comment on this post.



Or join even better, join our Discord

notes.title: Portals 🌀 Parkour Racing in 4D!
notes.content:
Hello Runners!
We're excited to share that Rocket Boots Mania now supports racing through the 4th dimension! Yup, we've added Portals to Create Mode and they are so much fun! 🤩

Portal Tower
You can find the first map with portals in the recommended section of Community Creations. Try it out and let us know how you like it. It's called "Portal Tower" 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/b0fb29ebeca09d4f27c3e99f0dd906584984f467.png
You can of course use the portals to build your own maps too! It's quite simple. Place both the 'in' and the 'out' portal in the Create Mode scene, select both and then hit [CTRL] + [SHIFT] + [L] to link them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/632ad1cd009ba99f740acb433eba02dd5c4de734.png
And yes, of course we're already planning future updates that will leverage this functionality to link other "logic" type objects like buttons, switches, gates and whatever else we come up with. Share your ideas in the comments here on Steam! 📝

If you're curious to see more about portals, check one of the livestreams where we were building the first portal map. Don't forget to subscribe to catch other updates early - we're usually live at least 3 times a week.
[previewyoutube=cvChEJp3WmM;full][/previewyoutube]
Create Mode Updates
You asked and you shall receive. Here are a bunch of additions to the Create Mode that were requested by you.

You can now choose between different environments / time of day conditions. Open the level menu (the three lines in the top left corner) and choose between 'Islands Dusk' and 'Islands Afternoon'. We'll continue adding the other environments (and maybe completely new ones) in the upcoming updates. What environments do you think would be coolest? Let us know! 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/e8d189bd3624fda19f3394fef7d42e170619cc57.png
There's now a new modular track pack of models that allow you to build gravity defying tracks just like those in the Snowman bonus level. Horizontal, vertical, there are really no limits to how you can use these.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/d043d9d0f2d431586b413ed942b6d59c6bd02df7.png
Of course we also had to include the shock gates for some additional challenge. 🤓

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/fd6111935468a919a71badb73273f34f5a8dca1c.png
And on a special request we've also added the individual crab model, please be nice to them! 😂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/2697a3bf79a3dbdcb0805a2b0dbc8b4f15881c06.png

New Outfit
We have a new awesome outfit for Zoe created by Soullessrun, thanks! 😍 If you'd like to create outfits or even completely new character models, stop by our Discord and we can teach you how.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/38c9d902ff9d696d37f130c593180d760f5478d1.png

Cloud Saves
Another frequently requested feature was added - cloud saves allow you to chase records on multiple devices and your progress will be automatically synced (as long as you're connected to the internet of course). Let us know if everything's working or if you encounter some issues.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/d1d30a24fd97006480763bd6662046b507706bae.png

Controls
Sometimes we get asked: "What's better - controller or keyboard and mouse?" While controller is the more chill way to play I'd recommend mouse and keyboard if you're serious about chasing the records. 
I'd also encourage you to bind jump to [Left Mouse Button]. I've done it a couple of months ago based on the recommendation from LinT and I just love it! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/6f592a108ec61904be6c57e0430164ef89d48415.png

All input can be changed in Settings > Input.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/094f2c8a334fecd982d9acb318a5094e0c11f857.png
To prove a point about total freedom of input mapping in our game I once mapped the controls to my racing sim, it was a surprisingly fun experience, check the video below 😂
[previewyoutube=sA_AAfP9EEY;full][/previewyoutube]

Temporary / FYI
As a part of full controller support for free camera, we moved camera acceleration button to be the same as nitro (Default is Right Mouse Button/RT2 on controller). This is temporary and in the next update there will be a dedicated mapping in the input settings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/03d0b7771132539719e33f315b524322d2f872b8.png

Bug fixing / Optimization
As usual we've done a bunch of things around the whole game to improve the experience. You can check the full log in the main menu for detailed information.

You've read all the way here? Let us know by hitting the like button further below, drop a comment, and join us on Discord! You certainly care about the game as much as we do and we’d love to hear your thoughts on this update as well as where you’d like the game to go next! Every like and comment helps grow the awareness of this awesome game, thanks! <3

👉 JOIN DISCORD 
👉 YOUTUBE

notes.title: Speedrun Mode and Much More!
notes.content:
Hello Runners!
Thank you for the incredible response to the 1.0 release! Seeing all the new records and community creations has been amazing 🤩

We have a another cool update for you today, so let's dive in!

Speedrun Mode 
This new mode unlocks after you finish the game, and the goal is simple: beat it as fast as possible! ⏱️

Collect 15,000 tokens to unlock the final level, complete it, and stop the dedicated in-game timer to secure your spot in the Speedrun Valhalla Leaderboard.

Huge thanks to our Discord beta testers and everyone joining our live streams to help us refine it! 😍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/8d8bc2889ca2bd845db79cfee05c32665736fc3b.png
New models for Create Mode
We see how much you're enjoying Create Mode, so we're giving you even more control over your creations! 👷‍♂️🚧

Island Pack
With this island pack, you can fully customize your environments! It includes an empty terrain, two medium rocks, one big rock, three palm trees, three flowers, and a fern.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/3139d4d3049037b50b8223a4d381e1e6ca57d58b.png
Modular Containers
You asked for ROCKETEX containers, and we delivered! We also tweaked their dimensions to make them modular, so they snap together easily. Now you can build mazes, structures, or anything else you can imagine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/625d2589e1821c70906771244225d1e91744f110.png
Glass Panels
Some of you loved the glass panels but needed doors and windows, so here they are! 🙂

And just in case you didn’t know, glass panels are slippery, making them perfect as blocker-type obstacles since players can't wallrun on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/03bcf73e331a8ebfb3717c49b99cab15d6ffca2f.png
Wood Crate
Of course, we had to add the legendary wood crate! Now you can practice box-jumping and create some awesome maps with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/bfb096fd6daec077683915ae21eac3d82831aacc.png
Fun fact: We discovered a physics bug with this crate model early in development. Jumping off the corners gives you a huge boost, opening up some incredible paths and WRs.

The community loved it so much that we decided to keep it as an actual feature of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/7e91b06149983739b5b70b0fd4d26635e33c2b11.png
New Character
You’ve probably noticed plenty of community-created outfits in the game. With this update, we’re introducing something completely unique: a brand-new character.

Meet Dino Muscle, created by Omed (aka KickyWonka), one of our amazing community members who has already built some incredible maps in Create Mode. 🤩 Unlike most user-created outfits, this one features a fully unique mesh and serves as a proof of concept for where we’d like to take the game next.

Over the past few months, we’ve developed a pipeline for importing custom-made characters. If you’d like to give it a shot, join us on Discord! We’ll show you how, whether it’s a simple texture modification or a brand-new model like Omed’s.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/729ebae546e3100e46919599692349f612d4a987.png
Restart to last Checkpoint
We already had a dedicated restart button, but some of you requested a "restart to last checkpoint" option. This quickly became a personal favorite for me, especially for Speedrun Mode.

By default, you can press [L] to restart to the last checkpoint. We placed it further from WSAD to avoid accidental triggers, but you can remap it in the settings as usual (I use [F] 🤓). You can also remap this on your gamepad as well. If there’s no checkpoint, this button will restart the level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/8b05a92ee811d69ee0c4937e85d5fe28a4cb3a29.png
Training Adjustments
We adjusted the level layout on the first training map, Rocket Jump. A full explanation, including a community-wide vote, can be found in our Discord polls channel, but here’s the TLDR:
The best path/strategy on this map could give new players the wrong impression.
We love the strat, but it's better suited for maps deeper in the game rather than the first level.
Training should welcome new players, not make them question the game. 😅
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/46ac30346d713a599401f90955f5153aff0648db.png
Optimization
Water reflections have been disabled in the Jungle Arena hub and levels.
This provides a significant performance boost for many players.
On my setup (a 5-year-old mid-tier gaming PC with an RTX 4070 Ti), FPS more than doubled!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/3d9218d52681fbcacdb4b7c3e5327c6b4af44caf.png
Other Improvements
As always, we've made a few other quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback. Check the in-game change log for the full list!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/91deeb8085ca472d1f03401e9b2175134153630c.png
Livestream
We stream live every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 8 PM Prague time / 11 AM PST.

Click the image to join today's stream, and consider subscribing to stay up to date! 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/ecd70c25b35bdef4826b5c1384eafac0d9ab5bb7.png
Some Thoughts on 1.0 and Future
If you've made it this far, I just want to say thank you for being a dedicated part of this community! It's because of players like you that we get to keep pushing forward on this amazing journey.

We've poured everything into building a solid game, and we're humbled by the 100% positive reviews so far. We'll do everything in our power to maintain that because we truly believe in our vision of Parkour Trackmania. This game is built together with an incredible community that keeps improving, creating awesome maps and skins, and helping it thrive for years to come.

This is just the beginning. While we may not have millions of players yet, I believe people will recognize what we've built and will join us soon.

Thanks for being here early, before we take off. You're legends.

Hit like, leave a comment, and join us on our live stream or Discord. We'd love to hear your thoughts on where you'd like the game to go next!

👉 JOIN DISCORD 
👉 YOUTUBE

notes.title: The CREATE MODE is here!🏃‍♂️🔥
notes.content:
Hello Runners!

It's been a minute since the last update and we are truly happy to be back with a bunch of cool updates! Obviously the big one is the Create Mode, but there's more, check the video 👇

[previewyoutube=TQKkDUPqIi0;full][/previewyoutube]
Alright, let's dig into it. Below you can read more about the Create Mode, Community Creations, Speed Effects, New HUD, New Training hub and the RocketEx lore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/02aecaa40c92fd09c8b88a490fd2e7f5dba5a6fa.jpg

The main item on our "Early Access list of promises" is now ready for testing. You can browse the library of models, place them in the scene, move and rotate them around to create your own maps! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/a05296dd96ac7cbff64ca7e628918a7b9520c98d.jpg
The community creations menu allows you to conveniently browse and play maps created by other players. It also allows you to easily find the "latest" uploaded creations or the "recommended" ones that we'd like to highlight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/63bdde5fbd5c25c7052ac125bd80883bd9e773ff.jpg
Special thanks to the few early creators from Discord that helped us iron out the initial bugs by submitting their awesome maps! 🙏

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/3a417dd7310d95890381e95faaf55d0106f9ad10.jpg
We added a few camera effects and new HUD to increase the sensation of going fast. As you build up speed the FOV increases, the edges of your screen become blurry and speed lines begin rendering around your character. The new HUD displays the amount of boost and nitro you currently have and also has a decent flame VFX to support the feeling of "being on fire"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/8845145c84f6579c28c7462aa8da5722cdc4e48e.jpg
We added a dedicated starting hub called "Training" with a couple of levels that teach new players the basics. We also implemented a new system for input which automatically detects whether you are playing on keyboard and mouse or controller and displays appropriate hints for controls mapping.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33601489/317559694876248c7350385971727d05c0ffc514.jpg
As we are nearing the release of the game we started considering other aspects, such as the lore. You can now find RocketEx containers scattered around the hubs and tracks. You will soon learn more about this company, what it does and what it stands for.

Other Improvements
As usual, there's a bunch of other improvements that you'll notice when chasing your records:
- New Rocket Boots VFX that are more clean and stylish
- Improved flying mechanics that allow you to more easily go in desired direction
- Improved lighting, materials, textures and sun reflections
- Smoother transitions between levels thanks to the hypertube system 
- Improved outfit selection screen that now filters individual characters
- Reworked parts of the Rocket Island with a new final zone
- Additional support for Controller and other input improvements
- Polished levels in Islands and Mountains hubs
- Slide is now a hold action
- Flip can now break objects
- Wallrun gives you a slight upward velocity when you begin wallrunning
- Other minor tweaks and bug fixes to improve the user experience

Consider joining our Discord to receive latest news, participate in beta testing, and most importantly to let us know what you think of this update.

👉 JOIN DISCORD 👈  

Have an amazing day! 🏃‍♂️🔥

Antonin

notes.title: Update [0.9.0] coming - READ MORE!
notes.content:
What is up Runners?! There is a huge update coming and you can already test it on our Discord:

JOIN DISCORD: https://discord.gg/rbm

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/f31c9fd0ef5a36473a890ba66ae98c098c34e6ec.jpg
(Discord skin by Kironet)

Here is a short list of all the new cool stuff that is part of the update:

GHOSTS
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/e8e9afb65a7e09070b4464546e4c5130e1274f15.jpg

 The first of 3 main milestones for our Early Access is DONE
 This technology enables us to capture and replay any run as well as prepare us for the next stage - multiplayer.
 Medals now have ghosts which are automatically selected when you play the level and give you motivation to improve.
 Gold and Ultima player runs are automatically captured and uploaded to our servers.
 You can select other players replay from the leaderboard and compete with them.
 

NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER - ZOE
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/a1d870aed4077ef0fa7ee6eecd67e2cf0d8b8b59.jpg

 We have been testing Zoe on our Discord server for quite some while and she is finally ready to be implemented in the game
 We have made adjustments to Zoes model and animations, she is now a bit younger (16-17 year old) and much more dynamic, closer to the feel of Ricky
 She feels amazing and you need to try her out!
 

JOIN DISCORD: https://discord.gg/rbm

NEW VISUAL STYLE + IMPROVED UI 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/d75ca02f917e93f8baad38ee2ed1f1a01dace84d.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/b01e4e0f268c583ab5eecdeb431aaa480f8cd219.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/01cfab9fdd7727d3a0c23934816f71b1a4dd1493.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/f9ec6db80d40a27a7af2dd77528ab047ea171485.jpg
 
 We've finalized the look of the game and are re-designing all Early Access levels
 We have started out with the Arenas, other areas will soon follow matching the same style
 We have a new map selection screen as well as more polished UI overall
 

TIME BASED LEADERBOARDS AND BONUS 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/d777084ee2c75017c033a87efc1f1e8674145469.jpg
 This was one of the most requested things and since we listen to our community we have switched from score to time and man, does it work much better!
  We have also added time bonuses in the levels that stimulate players to be creative and take harder paths.
 You can still cut the whole level but if you want to succeed in the leaderboards you might want to search for the best not the shortest path.
 

JOIN DISCORD: https://discord.gg/rbm

ROCKET BOOTS 2.0 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/17de5e8b2e3075d26933065a9895641b1fcbf8bd.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/c36ba1678e5f30237815048c3a33379a6d9f58b5.jpg

 The games indentity is Rocket Boots and it had to be reflected more in the game.
 Every time you perform a perfect jump a kickass particle is spawned letting you know this is what the game is about
 After a lot of playtesting we have arrived at a 20% charge increase per jump, with no additional charge for camera movement.
 With these changes the Rocket Boots feel amazing and we can't wait for you to try for yourself!
 Many of the mechanics that were present in the previous version were a bit too hardcore, we introduced new mechanic called "Fuel" which is designed to give the best possible experience to the casual player while not effecting the high end of the gameplay. After collecting fuel (only on some maps) you can use [RMB] to burn it and get speed
 We have refined the concept and got rid of the stuff that didnt make any sense (like the pipes and gates)
 The levels now start from a runner pose which gives the game a more race like feel.The levels end with a clearly defined Finish.
 

MEDAL SYSTEM REWORKED 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/6a471fdfc562ab0e9f4a05f0e5f28215a2644e58.jpg
 
 Thanks to the time based system and ghosts Gold is now a real achievment
 Ultima is now a true test of skill and the ultimate achievment and sure does feel like it
 

If you are already on our Discord you know all of this, but the reason we made this post was to let everyone else know what is going on. 

In case you werent on our Discord we do realize it might have seem as if we didnt continue the project and we do apologize for that, however the very oposite is true, we have been dedicated to this project and working extremely hard the whole time. Sure, we have taken a few wrong turns, but this is what game development is about and now we are able to stand here with this epic update that is coming your way.

The reason why we are so active on Discord is that it is a great platform for us to interact with you on daily bases, get your immediate feedback as you finish the level and share your thoughts right away. Updating the Steam version with each tiny playtest would be impossible and that is why we highly encourage you to join our Discord server to never miss another update:

JOIN DISCORD: https://discord.gg/rbm

So when is the next Steam update going to be released? You tell us! We do have about 20 re-designed levels with the time based leaderboards and we are wondering whether you'd appreciate having an update that has a fraction of the levels or if you'd like to wait a little longer and have all the levels. For us it doesn't really make that much different because we always release the levels on Discord for you to test them out, so it is up to you to let us know what you think!

! When you join our Discord, please PM me so I can give you the special role, so you have access to all builds !

Again, we cannot stress this enough, please do join our Discord!

Take care,

Antonin

PS: Join Discord <3

notes.title: RocketBoots Mania PAX Challenge!
notes.content:
HELLO RUNNERS!

Hope you had a great holiday break and you are ready to jump in to improve your records - because we most certainly are!

There is a couple of major updates waiting for you:

IDENTITY UPGRADE
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/91d147565762628f0cd63efc801c05cd75a20df9.jpg

As discussed in the previous updates and on our Discord we have gathered a lot of positive feedback since the Early Access launch, but we also pay close attention to the feedback from the players that decided not to buy our game. The single biggest reason for such a mistake (not buying our game) was the percieved identity mismatch - people either thought this is an endless runner (because of the old name "Ricky Runner" or they thought its an adventure game for kids (because of the cheerful and cute graphics). We are sure that with the new name RocketBoots Mania and the new art direction, no one will be mistaken this is a serious competitive title. Just you wait till you see our new character Zoe in action! Some sneak peak can alrady be seen on our Discord.


PAX CHALLENGE
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/d71e0f625b67c47e9f47457bcd9eeb0b537de818.png

We are thrilled about your feedback from the Xmas challenge and since we are going to PAX South we wanted to show off and decided to bring you a brand new and even better challenge. This one is actually based off a special Multiplayer preview map called "Shuffle" which is also included in this update and it is accessible through the Dev Area directly from main menu. Let us know how you like both the challenge and the Shuffle - multiplayer preview. Both of these maps feature a new mechanic / feature and that is the Jump pad.

MORE CONTROL
Holding the slide/pack button [SHIFT] before or while wallrunning cancels climb. More detailed info on this one in our recent blog post.


SUMMARY

 RocketBoots Mania indentity upgrade
 PAX Challenge
 Multiplayer preview arena - Shuffle
 Holding shift before or while wallrunning cancels climb
 New feature: Jump pads 
 Minor bug fixing


Can't wait for your feedback Runners! Stay strong!

notes.title: Ricky Runner: Updates + Join the Beta branch!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/4e0a6e68e8959938202fa3e1dbbb644a42513158.png
Hello Runners!! 
To make sure everyone is having fun and new features do not break anything we are using the Beta branch for the latest updates. When properly tested (usually less than a week) these changes are commited to the main public branch. Anyone is most welcome to participate in Beta testing

How to enable Beta
    Go to your Library
    Right Click "Ricky Runner" and select "Properties"
    Go to Betas tab
    Select the Public Beta
    type "RocketBootMania" into the code section and hit "Check Code"
    If everything went well, you should be on BETA branch

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601489/51675188e5d7c148b77a1a650dd15d4c1f31db7e.png
What is new on Beta branch

  new more secure and robust dll
  camera changed to center Ricky in the screen
  new section "Dev Area" -  an incubator for new arenas and other content, instead of adding the arenas directly to map, they can first be seen and tested here, there is no difference in functionality and your progress will not be affected when moving these to map
  Zero To Hero arena added to Dev Area
  Whale arena added to Dev Area
  BayWatch arena added to Dev Area
  GetWet arena added to Dev Area
  You get small amount of boost just by running for certain period of time
 Wallrun tutorial re-done to have pressure plates instead of levers
  Holodisplays are shown by default so people actually notice / read them (the pop ups in startpoints)
